omnibus: The Digital Omnibus, Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, entered into force on 27 July 2026 and reset the high-risk clock.
gpai: GPAI enforcement went live on 2 August 2026: the AI Office can demand documentation, evaluate models and require measures, with fines up to 3% of global annual turnover or EUR 15 million under Article 101.
bans: On 2 December 2026 the new Article 5 bans on AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery and child sexual abuse material apply, and providers of generative systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 must meet the Article 50(2) marking duty.
annex3: Annex III high-risk obligations were deferred by the Omnibus from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027.
annex1: Annex I embedded high-risk obligations were deferred by the Omnibus from 2 August 2027 to 2 August 2028.
public: High-risk systems intended for public authorities that were already on the market must comply by 2 August 2030.
stack: The stack has to exist before the deferred dates: build it in the order chapter 04 gives, layer by layer, starting now.
